WORK EXPERIENCE

Editorial Assistant and Reproducibility Coordinator at Meta-Psychology
Linnaeus University 2021 — Present

  • Conducted over 35 reproducibility checks of statistical analyses of various complexities, from simulations to multilevel models and meta-analyses.
  • Developed guidelines for reproducibility checks used by other reproducibility reviewers, and created guidelines for the journal’s reproducibility requirements.
  • Reviewed adherence to preregistrations of the submitted articles.

Research Assistant
Linnaeus University 2021 — 2022

  • Screened, extracted, synthesized and assessed risk of bias of original studies and systematic reviews in systematic and meta-reviews
